title: SecureReviewer: Enhancing Large Language Models for Secure Code Review through Secure-Aware Fine-Tuning
summary: The original SecureReviewer builds a security-focused review dataset, fine-tunes LLMs with a secure-aware objective, augments generation with retrieval, and evaluates both security issue detection and comment quality.
This reproduction uses simplified single-LLM prompts to classify security type and generate structured review comments over the SecureReviewer test set.
